scope: Up to 12 useful currently-missing university logos/campus images. All 12 definite items below are campus photographs from individual Wikimedia Commons file pages for universities with no attributed enrichment media and no official-logo record. Official brand logos are held as unresolved (permission unclear).
method: Read-only public media candidate review. No downloads, no asset replacement, no scraping of protected university directories, no uniRank logo harvest, no published-data/URL changes, no credential access, no Supabase writes. Web search integration was unavailable (cancelled); Commons file pages were located via prior cached search titles and verified one-by-one via single HTML fetches with delays (no API bulk harvest). Search access was never treated as licence; every licence/creator below comes from the individual Commons file page Licensing/Author section. Unknown dimensions/hashes remain null; no values invented.

duplicate_guards.result: none of the 12 definite candidates reuse those IDs, domains, or file pages; 9 overlap unattributed-thumbnail rows only as replacement targets with new per-file attribution, 3 are pure fallback rows
